# **II. Software Requirement Specification**

## **1\. Requirement Overview**

CareBridge is a community-driven maternal and early childhood health support platform. The system boundary includes Mobile App, Expert Portal, Admin & Moderation Portal, Backend Services, AI/RAG/Triage Service, Notification Service, Map Service, Health Device Platform and Phone IMU Sensor integration. CareBridge supports mothers, postpartum users, caregivers and families in tracking care journeys, saving personal records, joining a moderated community, reading verified content, receiving reminders, connecting with verified experts and using safety support features.

External entities include human actors such as Guest, User, Care Seeker, Family Member/Caregiver, Verified Expert, Moderator, Content Admin and Admin; and supporting service actors such as Payment Gateway, Notification Service, Map Service, Health Device Platform, AI Service and Phone IMU Sensor. Data exchange is controlled by RBAC, consent, scope, expiry, revoke and audit log principles.

### **1.1 Context Diagram**

#### ***1.1.1 Web App Context Diagram***

![][image2] 

**Figure 1: Context Diagram for Web App**

**Image Detail: [Context Diagram for Web App](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1H_01FTvFF4a2Eiakpnoc9WaPGs3b0Cba/view?usp=sharing)**

**Description**

| External Entity | Input to System Data Flow | Output from System Data Flow | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Guest / User | Registration, login, OTP | Auth status, account status | Primary web users for shared account, profile, search, report, and access-controlled functions. |
| Verified Expert | Expert profile, verification docs, availability, answers, consultation summaries | Question queue, bookings, shared summaries, earnings, verification/renewal status | Uses Expert Portal / Expert App capabilities to provide verified consultation and expert community support. |
| Community Moderator | Report lifecycle, moderation decisions, warnings/suspensions, topic governance | Moderation queue, reports, flagged content, account enforcement history | Reviews community content and account reports to keep interaction safe and respectful. |
| Content Admin | Articles, FAQs, checklists, pregnancy exercises, content categories/versions | Approval status, version history, unpublish/revision feedback | Manages verified content and knowledge materials used by users and Gemini RAG support. |
| System Admin | \- Manage users, roles, experts, AI/red-flag rules, posture config, dashboards\- Consultation lifecycle: reschedule, cancel, complete, no-show, dispute, refund | \- System reports, audit logs, security events and community/expert metrics\- Refund/dispute outcomes, commission and settlement reports | Administers platform operation, access, expert governance, pricing configuration, and security review. |
| VNPay Payment Gateway | Payment/refund/settlement status | Payment, refund, commission and reconciliation requests | Processes paid consultation transactions and returns payment results to CareBridge. |
| Firebase Cloud Messaging | Firebase delivery status | Firebase push notification requests | Delivers push and in-app notifications for consultation, moderation, reminder, and safety events. |
| Gemini AI Service (RAG / Triage Support) | Structured intake, RAG answer and triage support output | Gemini prompts for intake, RAG and red-flag support | Supports intake, FAQ/RAG response, summarization, and triage assistance without making independent medical decisions. |
| ZegoCloud Call Service (Video / Voice) | ZegoCloud call session status | Create ZegoCloud voice/video rooms | Provides realtime voice and video call rooms for consultation sessions. |
| Consent & Access Control Service | Access decision, sharing history | Consent checks, sharing scope, expiry/revoke | Controls whether health records, summaries, location, and shared care data may be accessed. |
| Firebase Storage (Health Records / Files) | File metadata, retrieval status, source labels | Upload/view shared health files and summaries | Stores health records and supporting files under CareBridge permission and consent rules. |
| Audit / Security Log Service | Audit trail, incident evidence, access history | Admin, consent, expert access, payment and security events | Preserves traceability for sensitive platform actions and security investigation. |
| Approved Content / RAG Knowledge Base | Approved knowledge for RAG and content discovery | Publish approved content, FAQ, checklist and exercise knowledge | Holds approved educational and checklist content used for verified content browsing and RAG retrieval. |

**Table 2: Context Diagram Description For Web App**

#### ***1.1.2 Mobile App Context Diagram***

![][image3]

**Figure 2: Context Diagram for Mobile App**

**Image Detail: [Context Diagram for Mobile App](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LA0wzs7vQmztxmqQQ7Klo82EMst6jRYP/view?usp=sharing)**

**Description**

| External Entity | Input to System Data Flow | Output from System Data Flow | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Mother | \- Profiles, pregnancy/postpartum journey, mother/baby logs, health records \- Community feed/Q\&A, reactions, bookmarks, reports, expert search \- Consultation booking lifecycle, payments, reviews, disputes/refunds \- Safety monitoring, emergency contacts, fall detection, confirmation, false-positive reports \- Care group, invitations, permissions, task assignment, shared calendar \- Pregnancy exercise sessions, vaccination records, growth measurements, expenses/checklists | \- Journey dashboard, reminders, charts, vaccination/growth, expense/checklist suggestions \- Community feed, answers, notifications, expert directory/profiles \- Booking status, session info, summaries, payment/refund results \- Safety alerts, emergency workflows, safety event history \- Shared schedule, task status, shared data and permission status \- Exercise results, vaccination schedule, growth history, expense/checklist summaries | Main mobile user managing maternal, baby, health record, consultation, emergency, and safety support features. |
| Family Member | Accept/reject invitations, view shared data, update/leave tasks | Emergency alerts, shared calendar/tasks/records, permission updates | Supports the mother/care seeker within a consented family care group. |
| Verified Expert | Availability, consultation response, chat/call/video, location visibility | Consultation requests, shared summaries, nearby support requests, route/contact context | Uses mobile/expert app capabilities for availability, nearby support, and realtime consultation. |
| Guest / User | \- Registration, login, OTP, password reset \- Profile, privacy settings, notification preferences, search/report | \- Auth status, onboarding result \- Notifications, account status, search/report results | Shared mobile account actor for authentication and general user functions. |
| VNPay Payment Gateway | Transaction/refund status | Consultation payment/refund requests | Processes paid consultation checkout from the mobile booking flow. |
| TrackAsia Map Service | TrackAsia nearby results, distance, routing and ETA | TrackAsia location, nearby facilities/experts, support request, route/ETA | Supports emergency map, nearby care, and consented expert support location features. |
| Smartwatch / Wearable Device | Device metrics, sync status, source/data-quality labels | Device connect/sync/import/disconnect requests | Provides supported wearable health data only after consent and with source labels. |
| Gemini AI Service (RAG / Triage Support) | Gemini structured intake, RAG answer and safety guidance | Gemini intake prompts, FAQs and selected health/device context | Supports AI nurse assistant and triage flows without replacing professional medical advice. |
| Firebase Cloud Messaging | Firebase delivery status by notification type | Reminder, community, consultation and emergency notification requests | Delivers mobile notifications and safety alerts. |
| ZegoCloud \+ Firebase Realtime (Calls / Chat) | ZegoCloud call status and Firebase chat status | \- Create ZegoCloud voice/video room \- Firebase handles chat messages | Supports chat through Firebase and voice/video calls through ZegoCloud. |

**Table 3: Context Diagram Description For Mobile App**

### **1.2 Main Workflow**

#### ***1.2.1 Maternal Care Plan Workflow***

![][image4]     

**Figure 3: Maternal Care Plan Workflow**

**Image Detail: [Maternal Care Plan Workflow](https://app.diagrams.net/#G14j9iTIV80PBuXQnsreYSclzdxtYSG1C1#%7B%22pageId%22%3A%229__zi6zAsn-RvBs5NyXi%22%7D)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Register Account / Login | The mother registers a new account or logs in to access the CareBridge platform. | Mother | This is the entry point of the workflow. |
| 2 | Send Health & Stage Survey | The system presents a health and lifecycle-stage survey to collect the information required for maternal care planning. | System | The survey supports preconception, pregnancy and postpartum stages. |
| 3 | Select Stage & Fill Health Survey | The mother selects the current stage—preconception, pregnancy or postpartum—and completes the corresponding health survey. | Mother | The selected stage determines the care context used by the system. |
| 4 | Save Information & Generate Care Journey | The system stores the submitted information and generates a stage-appropriate maternal care journey. | System | The generated journey becomes the basis for the daily care plan. |
| 5 | Receive Daily Plan | The mother receives a daily plan containing relevant care activities, reminders and health-support content. | Mother | The plan is updated according to the active stage and available health information. |
| 6 | Health Concern Detected? | The workflow checks whether a health concern has been reported by the mother or identified from submitted health information or tracked metrics. | Mother / System | If no concern is detected, the mother continues routine care. If a concern is detected, the workflow proceeds to consultation assessment. |
| 7 | Perform Ongoing Care Activities | The mother tracks health metrics, manages reminders, performs pregnancy exercises when applicable and reads verified health content. | Mother | These activities form the recurring daily-care loop. |
| 8 | Get AI Nurse Triage | The mother receives AI-assisted symptom intake, risk triage and guidance based on the available information. | Mother / AI Nurse Service | The AI Nurse provides support and risk classification, not a medical diagnosis. |
| 9 | Need Expert Consultation? | The workflow determines whether the mother needs support from a verified expert. | Mother / System | Yes routes to expert recommendation. No routes to AI Nurse triage for automated assessment and guidance. |
| 10 | Recommend Available Experts | The system recommends available verified experts who are suitable for the mother's consultation need. | System | A rejected booking returns to this step so another expert can be selected. |
| 11 | Book Expert Consultation | The mother selects an expert and submits a consultation booking request. | Mother | The request is sent to the selected expert. |
| 12 | Receive Consultation Request | The expert receives and reviews the mother's consultation request. | Expert | The request includes the booking details and permitted context. |
| 13 | Accept Booking? | The expert accepts or rejects the consultation booking. | Expert | If rejected, the system recommends another available expert. If accepted, the consultation proceeds. |
| 14 | Chat and Video Consultation | The mother and the expert communicate through chat or video consultation. | Mother / Expert | The consultation outcome is used to refine the care plan. |
| 15 | Receive Personalized Care Plan | The mother receives a personalized care plan based on the available health information, AI triage result or expert consultation outcome. | Mother | This is the final output of the workflow and may support subsequent ongoing care. |

**Table 4: Maternal Care Plan Workflow Description**

#### ***1.2.2 Baby Care Journey & Growth Workflow***

![][image5]    

**Figure 4: Baby Care & Growth Workflow**

**Image Detail: [Baby Care & Growth Workflow](https://app.diagrams.net/#G14j9iTIV80PBuXQnsreYSclzdxtYSG1C1#%7B%22pageId%22%3A%22ikUBUMVSAlDU56C6-_KZ%22%7Dhttps://app.diagrams.net/#G14j9iTIV80PBuXQnsreYSclzdxtYSG1C1#%7B%22pageId%22%3A%22ikUBUMVSAlDU56C6-_KZ%22%7D)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | Create baby profile | The mother creates a profile for the baby to begin the baby care and growth workflow. | Mother | The baby profile provides the information required to generate the Baby Care Plan. |
| 2 | Generate Baby Care Plan | The system uses the baby profile information to generate a Baby Care Plan for the active baby profile. | System | This step initializes the plan used in the recurring baby-care cycle. |
| 3 | Receive Daily Baby Care Plan | The mother receives the current Daily Baby Care Plan and uses it as the starting point for daily care activities. | Mother | After Step 10, the workflow loops back to this step for the next care cycle. |
| 4 | Record feeding, sleep, diaper, symptom or night-mode journal | The mother records daily baby-care information, including feeding, sleep, diaper activity, symptoms or night-mode journal entries. | Mother | These entries support observation and care continuity; they are not medical diagnoses. |
| 5 | Add growth measurement or development milestone | The mother records a supported growth measurement or an observed development milestone for the active baby profile. | Mother | A measurement or milestone may be added when applicable and is not necessarily entered every day. |
| 6 | Store baby logs, measurements and milestone history | The system stores the submitted baby-care journals, growth measurements and development milestone history for the active baby profile. | System | Stored information is retained for later review and timeline display. |
| 7 | Apply age/stage reference labels for observation only | The system applies age- or stage-based reference labels to the stored information to support observation. | System | Reference labels are informational only and must not be interpreted as a diagnosis or developmental assessment. |
| 8 | Add vaccination record or view source-labelled reference schedule | The mother may add a vaccination record for the baby or view a source-labelled vaccination reference schedule. | Mother | The reference schedule is informational; actual vaccination records remain associated with the active baby profile. |
| 9 | Send due/overdue vaccination or appointment reminder | The system sends a reminder when a vaccination or appointment is due or overdue based on the available schedule and recorded information. | System | The reminder supports follow-up and appointment preparation and does not replace professional advice. |
| 10 | Review active baby journals, growth chart, milestones and vaccination status | The mother reviews the active baby's journals, growth chart, recorded milestones and vaccination status. | Mother | After review, the workflow returns to the Daily Baby Care Plan for the next recurring care cycle. |
| Boundary | Workflow boundary | The workflow supports observation and appointment preparation. It does not diagnose conditions, assess child development or replace pediatric care. | System / Mother | This boundary applies to all activities in the workflow. |

Table 5: Baby Care Journey & Growth Workflow Description

#### ***1.2.3 Community Q\&A & Moderation Workflow***

![][image6]    

**Figure 5: Community Q\&A & Moderation Workflow**

**Image Detail: [Community Q\&A & Moderation Workflow](https://app.diagrams.net/#G14j9iTIV80PBuXQnsreYSclzdxtYSG1C1#%7B%22pageId%22%3A%22J9ntPpUS_PEAQUcgKipi%22%7D)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | View feed, search/filter topics or open question detail | The mother or family member views the community feed, searches or filters topics, or opens a question detail screen. | Mother / Family Member | This is the entry point for browsing community content before creating a question or submitting an answer. |
| 2 | Create question or submit answer | The mother or family member creates a new community question or submits an answer to an existing question, then chooses a public or anonymous community identity. | Mother / Family Member | The content is assigned status AI\_PENDING and remains visible only to the author until automated screening is completed. |
| 3 | Async AI scan for spam, abuse and prohibited advertising | The system asynchronously screens the submitted content for spam, abusive content and prohibited advertising. | System | The AI scan is a preliminary screening step and does not directly apply moderator enforcement actions. |
| 4 | Potential policy violation? | The system determines whether the AI scan indicates a potential violation of community policy. | System | If No, the content proceeds directly to approval and publication. If Yes, the content is sent for moderator review. |
| 5 | Moderator reviews flagged content and available evidence | The community moderator reviews the flagged content and any available evidence to determine whether the content complies with community policy. | Community Moderator | While under review, the content status is PENDING and the content requires moderation. |
| 6 | Approve content? | The community moderator decides whether the reviewed content may be approved for publication. | Community Moderator | If Yes, the workflow proceeds to Step 7A. If No, it proceeds to Step 7B. |
| 7A | Publish safe content | The system publishes approved content to the community feed, list or question-detail screen. | System | The content status is updated to APPROVED. This step is also used when the AI scan finds no potential policy violation. |
| 7B | Apply moderation action and record outcome | The community moderator may hide, reject, warn, suspend or request an edit, and records the moderation outcome for audit purposes. | Community Moderator | Depending on the action, the content status may be DELETED, HIDDEN or LOCKED. |
| 8 | Notify content outcome and retain traceable event | The system sends the publication or moderation outcome to the content author and retains a traceable event for audit and review. | System | Both the approved and moderated branches converge at this step. |
| 9 | Receive content status notification | The mother or family member receives a notification showing the current status or moderation result of the submitted question or answer. | Mother / Family Member | The workflow ends after the author receives the content status notification. |

Table 6: Community Q\&A & Moderation Workflow Description

#### ***1.2.4 Verified Expert Network & Contribution Workflow***

**![][image7]** 

**Figure 6: Verified Expert Network & Contribution Workflow**

**Image Detail: [Verified Expert Network & Contribution Workflow](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1O0JLtpq4eDFnLFeA0M6OvHjW1h2S3sTk/view?usp=sharing)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | Expert Identity Submission | The expert uploads a selfie together with the front and back images of the identity document. | Expert | All identity files are treated as protected sensitive data and must be submitted before credential review. |
| 2 | Expert Credential Submission | The expert submits specialty evidence, professional license files and the corresponding expiration date. | Expert | The credential package must identify the claimed specialty and include valid, readable supporting documents. |
| 3 | Add to Pending Review Queue | The system stores the identity and credential package and adds the application to the pending review queue for an administrator. | System | The application status is set to Pending Review; the expert is not yet displayed as verified. |
| 4 | Admin Reviews Case | The administrator fetches the queued review case and inspects the submitted identity files, credential files and related data. | Admin | The review action should record the reviewer, review time and assessment result for audit purposes. |
| D1 | Identity & Docs Approved? | The administrator decides whether the submitted identity and professional documents satisfy the verification requirements. | Admin | Yes leads to Step 5B. No leads to Step 5A. |
| 5A | Request More Info / Reject | The administrator requests missing or corrected information, or rejects the application, and provides specific reasons for the failed review. | Admin | The reasons are shown to the expert and retained in the review history. |
| 5A-1 | Expert Resubmits Data | The expert updates the requested files or information and resubmits the application for another verification review. | Expert | The resubmitted application returns to the identity and credential submission and review flow. |
| 5B | Publish Verified Status | After approval, the system marks the expert profile as active and verified. | System | Only an approved expert with valid, non-expired credentials may display the verified status. |
| 6 | Expert Community Contribution | The verified expert answers community questions and shares professional knowledge within the approved specialty scope. | Expert | All contributions remain subject to community, moderation and professional conduct policies. |
| 7 | Record Points & Badges | The system records eligible participation points and badges and updates the expert trust level based on contribution activity. | System | Points and badges represent participation and trust signals, not a guarantee of clinical competence or outcome. |
| D2 | Policy Violation or License Expired? | The system or administrator determines whether a policy violation has occurred or the expert license has expired. | Admin | Yes leads to Step 8A. No ends the workflow with the current verified state unchanged. |
| 8A | Admin Reviews Incident | The administrator reviews the incident, evaluates its severity and decides the appropriate enforcement action. | Admin | The decision should be supported by evidence and recorded in the audit history. |
| 8B | Restrict & Suspend | The system applies the administrator's decision by hiding the badge, restricting contributions, revoking verification or suspending the expert account. | System | The applied restriction ends the workflow and the expert profile is updated according to the final action. |

**Table 7: Verified Expert Network & Contribution Workflow Description**

#### ***1.2.5 AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage Workflow***

**Figure 7: AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage Workflow**

**Image Detail: [AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage Workflow](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LknD5YWbxhhFkyWWBnOBnhlCWugUd0iw/view)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | Enter symptoms, concern or care question | The mother or caregiver submits a concern from any active lifecycle stage. | Mother / Caregiver | The assistant is not an emergency service or diagnostic tool. |
| 2 | Select minimum health-record context | The app allows the user to select only the minimum relevant record context under explicit consent. | Mobile App | Context sharing is optional, scoped and revocable. |
| 3 | Build structured intake | The app structures the concern with approved knowledge context and an origin token for return-to-origin behavior. | Mobile App | The intake excludes unnecessary private data. |
| 4 | Generate non-diagnostic AI orientation | The AI assistant returns a structured orientation and reviewed citations without assigning the final risk level. | AI Nurse Assistant | No diagnosis, prescription or autonomous clinical decision. |
| 5A | GREEN safe guidance | CareBridge rules show a disclaimer, self-care information and monitoring guidance. | CareBridge Safety Rules / Next Action | The user is told what changes require reassessment. |
| 5B | YELLOW follow-up guidance | CareBridge rules offer a verified expert or checklist and request consent before sharing minimum context. | CareBridge Safety Rules / Next Action | No health context is shared without explicit consent. |
| 5C | RED emergency escalation | CareBridge rules idempotently open or reuse the MF-07 emergency session. | CareBridge Safety Rules / Next Action | RED handling is owned by deterministic CareBridge rules. |
| 6 | Persist outcome and return to origin | The system stores the triage outcome and chosen safe action, then returns the user to the originating dashboard. | CareBridge System / Mother | If AI is unavailable or intake is incomplete, conservative deterministic fallback guidance is used. |

**Table 8: AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage Workflow Description**

#### ***1.2.6 Emergency Map Nearby Support Workflow***

**Figure 8: Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support Workflow**

**Image Detail: [Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support Workflow](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1G9QFP61G7pQ8Gya5lU80sn2a66ZZUKBU/view)**

**Description**

| \# | Step Name | Detail Description | Role | Note |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | :---: | :---: |
| 1 | Open or resume emergency session | The mother or caregiver opens or resumes emergency support from a dashboard, RED triage result or safety alert. | Mother / Caregiver | The same active emergency session is reused when possible. |
| 2 | Request location permission and emergency consent | The app requests location access and emergency-mode consent while keeping quick call available. | Mobile App | Location denial must not block default guidance or quick call. |
| 3A | Search nearby care and support options | With consented location, TrackAsia searches nearby care facilities and eligible support options. | TrackAsia Map Service | Results are ordered by distance, relevance and available safety information. |
| 3B | Use manual fallback | Without available or consented location, the app accepts manual location and shows quick call and default emergency guidance. | Mobile App | Fallback remains usable without precise device location. |
| 4 | Return distance, route and ETA | The map service returns available distance, route and estimated travel time for the selected destination. | TrackAsia Map Service | ETA is informational and may be unavailable. |
| 5 | Display prioritized safe actions | The app shows route, navigation, quick-call and other prioritized safe-action options. | Mobile App | The system does not dispatch an ambulance. |
| 6 | Call facility, emergency contact or nearby support | The user initiates a call to the selected facility, emergency contact or consented nearby support participant. | Family / Facility / Nearby Support | CareBridge cannot guarantee that a person or expert will respond. |
| 7 | Send time-limited family / location alert | When explicitly enabled, the system sends a recipient-scoped alert containing only the approved location and time window. | Family / Facility / Nearby Support | Recipient and expiry are mandatory. |
| 8 | Record safe action and outcome | The app records the selected action and emergency outcome and returns to the originating dashboard when appropriate. | Mobile App | Outcome recording must preserve emergency-session continuity. |

**Table 9: Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support Workflow Description**

## **2\. User Requirements**

### **2.1 Actors**

| \# | Actor | Description |
| :---: | :---: | ----- |
| 1 | **Guest** | A non-authenticated visitor who can access public content and start account registration. This actor has limited access and cannot use personalized functions until login or account verification is completed. |
| 2 | **User** | A general parent actor for all authenticated accounts in the CareBridge system. This actor shares common functions such as authentication, profile management, notification settings, search, reporting, and permission-based access. |
| 3 | **Mother** | The main end-user of the mobile application. This actor manages pregnancy, postpartum, mother and baby care journeys, asks community questions, stores personal health records, books consultations, receives reminders, and accesses emergency or safety support features. |
| 4 | **Family Member**  | A family member or secondary caregiver invited to join a care group. This actor can view shared data, receive assigned tasks, get alerts, and support the care seeker according to granted permissions. |
| 5 | **Verified Expert** | A verified healthcare-related expert such as a doctor, nutritionist, lactation consultant, psychologist, or child development specialist. This actor can manage an expert profile, answer questions, provide consultation support, and interact with users within professional and safety boundaries. |
| 6 | **Moderator** | A community moderation actor responsible for reviewing posts, comments, answers, reports, and community violations. This actor helps maintain safe, respectful, and reliable community interactions. |
| 7 | **Content Admin** | An administrative actor responsible for creating, editing, reviewing, and versioning educational content such as articles, FAQs, checklists, and verified guidance materials. |
| 8 | **Admin** | The system administrator who manages users, roles, expert verification, dashboards, safety rules, configuration, and overall platform operation. |
| 9 | **Payment Gateway** | An external payment service that processes paid consultation transactions and returns payment status or transaction results to the CareBridge system. |
| 10 | **TrackAsia Map Service** | An external map service that supports geocoding, nearby healthcare place search, distance calculation, route guidance, and estimated travel time for emergency map and nearby care support. |
| 11 | **Smartwatch / Wearable Device** | An external wearable or smartwatch data source that can provide supported health metrics only when the user grants consent. Imported data must keep source labels and timestamps. |
| 12 | **Gemini AI Service** | The AI service used by CareBridge for intake structuring, normalization, summarization, FAQs, and RAG-supported responses; it does not make independent medical decisions. |
| 13 | **Firebase Cloud Messaging** | The notification service used to deliver push and in-app alerts for reminders, care tasks, consultation updates, moderation results, and emergency or safety events. |
| 14 | **Phone Motion / IMU Sensor** | The accelerometer and gyroscope on the phone provide motion data for safety monitoring. Raw data should preferably be processed on device and must not be considered medical-device data. |
| 15 | **ZegoCloud \+ Firebase Realtime / Chat** | Realtime communication services used for authenticated consultation sessions: ZegoCloud supports voice/video calls, while Firebase Realtime / Chat supports chat threads. |
| 16 | **Firebase Storage** | The file storage service used for uploaded health records, images, and supporting files. Access to stored health files is governed by CareBridge permissions and consent rules. |
| 17 | **MediaPipe Pose Analysis** | The on-device posture analysis capability used for pregnancy exercise posture support. It assists pose landmark analysis and must not be treated as medical diagnosis or clinical assessment. |

**Table 11: Actor Description**

#### ***2.2.2 Descriptions***

| ID | Use Case | Actor | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UC-01 | Register Account | Guest | Creates a Mother, Family or Expert account, captures the initial role, verifies the supported contact channel through OTP and allows OTP resend within the same registration flow. |
| UC-02 | Login | Guest | Authenticates a supported account by email, phone or Google and routes the user to the role-appropriate workspace. |
| UC-03 | Logout | Authenticated User | Ends the current authenticated session and returns the user to a public or login screen. |
| UC-04 | Reset Password | Guest | Requests and completes password recovery using the registered contact channel and a valid time-limited verification proof. |
| UC-05 | Change Password | Authenticated User | Changes the signed-in user’s password after validating the current password and password policy. |
| UC-06 | Manage Account Profile | Authenticated User | Views and updates the user’s supported personal profile and contact information. |
| UC-07 | Manage Notifications | Authenticated User | Lists notification items, opens notification details and marks individual or eligible notification items as read. |
| UC-08 | Manage Privacy and Data Permissions | Authenticated User | Reviews privacy state and grants, reviews or revokes scoped data-sharing permissions. |
| UC-09 | Deactivate or Delete Own Account | Authenticated User | Requests account deactivation or deletion subject to current retention and audit rules. |
| UC-10 | Submit Account Lock Appeal | Locked User | Submits an appeal for the current account-lock episode using the supported appeal proof. |
| UC-11 | Browse Community Q\&A | Mother / Family / Expert | Browses the approved community feed, opens question details and, for Mother or Family, reviews their own questions. |
| UC-12 | Answer Community Questions as Verified Expert | Verified Expert | Reviews the expert question queue and creates, updates or removes the expert’s answer with the current verified-expert label. |
| UC-13 | Register and Submit Expert Application | Expert Applicant | Completes expert onboarding, creates the professional application and submits required identity and verification evidence. |
| UC-14 | Manage Expert Professional Profile | Expert | Views and updates the professional profile, manages credentials and documents and reviews or renews verification status. |
| UC-15 | Manage Expert Availability | Expert | Views the calendar, creates or removes availability slots and changes supported online availability state. |
| UC-16 | Process Expert Conversation Requests | Expert | Lists and opens assigned requests and accepts or rejects a request; acceptance creates or links the direct conversation. |
| UC-17 | Use Direct Expert Chat | Mother / Family / Expert | Lists and opens direct conversations and exchanges text, image or document messages, including attachment viewing and eligible recall. |
| UC-18 | Conduct Direct Voice or Video Call | Mother / Family / Expert | Starts, answers, declines and ends an authorized voice or video call inside an accepted direct conversation. |
| UC-19 | Manage Own Login Sessions | Authenticated User | Views the user’s login sessions and revokes a selected session when supported. |
| UC-20 | Manage Mother Journey | Mother | Creates and updates a preconception, pregnancy or postpartum journey, records stage transitions or pregnancy outcome and views the journey dashboard. |
| UC-21 | Manage Maternal Health Metrics | Mother | Adds, views, updates and removes supported maternal measurements and reviews their detail and trend. |
| UC-22 | Manage Postpartum Logs | Mother | Adds, views, updates and deletes postpartum recovery observations. |
| UC-23 | Manage Maternal Health Records | Mother | Creates, views, updates and archives maternal health records and manages their protected attachments. |
| UC-24 | Manage Appointments | Mother | Creates, views, updates and deletes appointments through the appointment calendar and detail screens. |
| UC-25 | Manage Reminders and Schedules | Mother | Creates medication and other reminders, manages recurrence schedules and performs snooze, complete, skip, enable or delete actions. |
| UC-26 | View Today Care Tasks | Mother | Displays today’s reminders, appointments and current care tasks from the implemented home/task view. |
| UC-27 | Browse Pregnancy Exercises | Mother | Browses reviewed pregnancy exercises and opens exercise instructions and safety information. |
| UC-28 | Complete Pre-exercise Safety Check | Mother | Completes the required safety questions before an exercise session and stops entry when a configured warning condition applies. |
| UC-29 | Perform Camera-guided Exercise Session | Mother | Starts, pauses, resumes and completes an exercise session with optional camera-based real-time posture analysis after permission. |
| UC-30 | View Exercise History and Results | Mother | Views completed exercise sessions, posture feedback and the recorded session result. |
| UC-31 | Record Quick Health Notes | Mother | Records supported BMI, hydration, mood and fetal-movement quick notes. |
| UC-32 | Manage EPDS Screening | Mother | Completes EPDS screening, receives the supported safety response and reviews previous screening results. |
| UC-33 | View Personalized Care Recommendations | Mother | Displays current stage-based care recommendations produced by the implemented recommendation flow. |
| UC-34 | Manage Baby Profiles | Mother | Creates, views, updates, switches and archives baby profiles while preserving linked care history. |
| UC-35 | Manage Baby Daily Logs | Mother | Creates, views, updates and deletes feeding, sleep and diaper observations and reviews their summary. |
| UC-36 | Manage Development Milestones | Mother | Records, reviews, updates and deletes caregiver-observed development milestones. |
| UC-37 | Manage Baby Growth | Mother | Records, updates and deletes growth measurements and reviews measurement history and growth charts. |
| UC-38 | Manage Vaccination Journey | Mother | Views the vaccination schedule, manages vaccination records, completes or postpones a dose and creates related reminders. |
| UC-39 | Manage Baby Health Records | Mother | Creates, views, updates and archives health records scoped to the selected baby. |
| UC-40 | Manage Community Questions | Mother / Family | Creates, edits and deletes the actor’s own community questions under moderation rules. |
| UC-41 | Manage Community Answers | Mother / Family | Posts, edits and deletes the actor’s own community answers as personal community contributions. |
| UC-42 | Report Community Content or Account | Authenticated User | Submits a report against supported community content or an account with a reason and evidence allowed by the form. |
| UC-43 | Browse Expert Directory | Mother / Family | Searches the verified expert directory and opens an expert’s public professional profile. |
| UC-44 | Manage Own Expert Conversation Requests | Mother / Family | Creates, views and cancels the actor’s free conversation requests to an expert. |
| UC-45 | Use AI Nurse Symptom Triage | Mother | Starts structured symptom intake, supplies follow-up information and receives a non-diagnostic risk result and next-step guidance. |
| UC-46 | View AI Triage History | Mother / Authorized Family | Reviews previous AI triage sessions within the current permission scope. |
| UC-47 | Escalate AI Triage to Emergency Support | Mother | Opens the emergency support flow when the triage result or red-flag handling requires urgent action. |
| UC-48 | Request Expert Support from AI Triage | Mother / Family | Creates a free expert conversation request using the supported context from an AI triage session. |
| UC-49 | Find Nearby Care Facility | Mother / Family | Opens the emergency map, searches nearby facilities and reviews facility details, distance, route and ETA. |
| UC-50 | Call or Navigate to Care Facility | Mother / Family | Starts a device call to a selected facility or opens navigation for its location. |
| UC-51 | Call Emergency Number 115 | Mother / Family | Starts a device call to emergency number 115 after the actor confirms the action. |
| UC-52 | Alert Family During Emergency | Mother | Sends the implemented family emergency alert with only the authorized context and location state. |
| UC-53 | View Emergency or Family Alert | Mother / Family | Opens the detail of an emergency or family alert available to the current actor. |
| UC-54 | Manage Care Groups | Mother | Creates, views, updates and deletes the Mother’s care groups; member invitation, permission and membership actions remain in their dedicated cooperative-care use cases. |
| UC-55 | Manage Care Group Invitations | Mother / Family | Sends, lists and revokes invitations and allows the invited Family member to accept or reject them. |
| UC-56 | Manage Family Permissions | Mother | Grants and changes the exact care-data categories a Family member may access. |
| UC-57 | View Shared Care Data | Authorized Family | Views only the maternal data, quick-note history and other care information explicitly shared with the Family member. |
| UC-58 | View Shared Care Calendar | Mother / Authorized Family | Displays appointments and supported care events shared within an active care group. |
| UC-59 | Manage Cooperative Care Tasks | Mother / Family | Creates, views, updates, cancels and completes assigned care tasks according to care-group role. |
| UC-60 | Manage Care Group Membership | Mother / Family | Allows the Mother to remove a member and an active Family member to leave a care group. |
| UC-61 | View Family Alerts | Authorized Family | Lists and opens safety or emergency alerts shared with the Family member. |
| UC-62 | Browse Verified Content and FAQ | Mother / Family | Browses, searches and opens approved stage- and topic-based articles and FAQs. |
| UC-63 | Manage Personal Care Checklist | Mother / Authorized Family | Imports a template and creates, views, updates, deletes, completes or reopens personal checklist tasks and reviews history. |
| UC-64 | Manage Safety Monitoring Settings | Mother | Configures, enables and disables phone-IMU safety monitoring and its authorized alert behavior. |
| UC-65 | Respond to Suspected Fall or Impact | Mother / Phone Motion Sensors | Detects a suspected fall or impact and lets the Mother confirm safety or request help within the response window. |
| UC-66 | Send Safety Emergency Alert | Mother | Sends an emergency alert to configured authorized contacts when the safety flow requires escalation. |
| UC-67 | Review Safety Events and Report False Positive | Mother | Reviews safety-event history and marks an eligible detection as a false positive for monitoring feedback. |
| UC-68 | Open Emergency Support from Safety Alert | Mother | Opens emergency map, call and family-support actions from an active safety alert. |
| UC-69 | View Admin Dashboard | CareBridge System Admin | Displays current administrative account, expert, content and security summary information. |
| UC-70 | Manage User Accounts and Roles | CareBridge System Admin | Lists, searches and opens users, reviews activity and changes supported account status, role or access state. |
| UC-71 | Create Staff Account | CareBridge System Admin | Creates an authorized Moderator, Content Admin or other supported staff account. |
| UC-72 | Review Account Lock Appeals | CareBridge System Admin | Lists and opens lock appeals and records an approve or reject decision. |
| UC-73 | Review Audit and Security Operations | CareBridge System Admin | Reviews audit logs, security events and incident timelines, adds investigation notes and resolves supported incidents. |
| UC-74 | Manage CareBridge System Configuration | CareBridge System Admin | Views and updates the supported runtime configuration exposed by the CareBridge System Configuration workspace. |
| UC-75 | View Moderator Dashboard | Moderator | Displays moderation workload, community and handling summaries. |
| UC-76 | Review Pending Community Content | Moderator | Lists and opens pending community questions or answers for moderation review. |
| UC-77 | Monitor Published Community Content | Moderator | Browses visible community content and opens a selected item for moderation inspection. |
| UC-78 | Manage Community Reports | Moderator | Lists, claims, releases and opens content/account reports, reviews related evidence and resolves the report. |
| UC-79 | Apply and Review Moderation Actions | Moderator | Applies supported content or account actions, reviews violation history and undoes an eligible moderation action. |
| UC-80 | Review AI Moderation Assessment | Moderator | Views AI moderation assessment details and submits moderator feedback where implemented. |
| UC-81 | Manage Community Topics | Moderator | Creates, updates, orders and hides community topics exposed by the moderation workspace. |
| UC-82 | Review Expert Applications and Trust | CareBridge System Admin | Lists expert cases, opens submitted evidence, approves or rejects verification and changes supported expert trust status. |
| UC-83 | Manage AI Red-Flag Rules | CareBridge System Admin | Lists, creates, updates and deletes permitted red-flag rules used by the structured triage flow. |
| UC-84 | View Content Administration Workspace | Content Admin | Displays the Content Admin dashboard and browses the content library and its status filters. |
| UC-85 | Manage Verified Articles | Content Admin | Creates, views, updates, versions, archives or unpublishes verified articles through the implemented lifecycle. |
| UC-86 | Manage Verified FAQs | Content Admin | Creates, views, updates, versions, archives or unpublishes verified FAQ entries through the implemented lifecycle. |
| UC-87 | Manage Content Topics | Content Admin | Creates, updates, orders and changes visibility of article and FAQ topics. |
| UC-88 | Review and Approve Content | CareBridge System Admin | Lists pending content versions, opens the submitted version and records the supported approval decision. |
| UC-89 | Manage Checklist Templates | Content Admin / CareBridge System Admin | Creates, views, updates, clones, reviews, approves and archives checklist template versions according to role. |
| UC-90 | Manage Pregnancy Exercise Content | Content Admin | Creates, views, previews, updates and changes supported publication state for pregnancy exercise content. |
| UC-91 | Manage Exercise Posture Configuration | CareBridge System Admin | Creates, views and updates posture-analysis configuration associated with supported exercises. |

#### ***4.1.4 Non-Screen Functions***

| STT | Feature | System Function | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | OTP Issuance and Verification Service | Generates expiring OTP challenges, enforces resend and attempt limits, verifies the submitted code and records security-relevant outcomes. |
| 2 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Authentication Token and Session Service | Issues short-lived access tokens and device-specific refresh sessions, rotates tokens, detects revoked or expired sessions and supports sign-out from selected devices. |
| 3 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | RBAC Authorization Service | Evaluates role, permission, ownership, account state and platform context before protected data or operations are allowed. |
| 4 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Consent Scope and Expiry Service | Creates, validates, edits, expires and revokes permissions by recipient, purpose, data scope and time limit; access is denied when any condition is no longer valid. |
| 5 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Privacy Preference Enforcement Service | Applies profile visibility, online-status, location and data-use settings consistently to search, community, expert discovery and notification processing. |
| 6 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Account Deactivation Service | Temporarily disables sign-in and nonessential notifications, revokes active sessions and preserves data for possible reactivation under policy. |
| 7 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Account Deletion Workflow Job | Creates a deletion request, checks the waiting period and active retention or care-group obligations, anonymizes or deletes eligible data, and preserves only required audit evidence. |
| 8 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Expert Credential Expiry Monitor | Checks credential expiry dates, notifies experts before expiry and changes verification state when evidence is no longer valid. |
| 9 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Expert Verification Renewal Service | Validates renewal submissions, links new evidence to prior verification, routes review to System Admin and applies approved expiry dates or required-supplement status. |
| 10 | MF-01 Account, Trust & Access Control | Expert Suspension Enforcement Service | Disables the expert badge, public discovery, nearby-support eligibility and restricted expert actions while preserving audit and appeal access as configured. |
| 11 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Journey Stage Calculation Service | Calculates pre-pregnancy, pregnancy week or postpartum stage from user-provided dates and refreshes stage-dependent dashboard data. |
| 12 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Exercise Catalog Eligibility Service | Returns only active exercises matching the selected trimester, difficulty and supported duration; it does not automatically prescribe an exercise as medical treatment. |
| 13 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Pre-exercise Safety Rule Service | Evaluates required safety answers against configured blocking and caution rules before an exercise session may start. |
| 14 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Exercise Session State Service | Creates and transitions exercise sessions through started, paused, resumed, completed and abandoned states and stores duration and completion metadata. |
| 15 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Posture Analysis Runtime Service | Processes live camera landmarks using the configured rule-based or ML-based mode and returns bounded posture feedback without saving raw camera video. |
| 16 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Exercise Result Aggregation Service | Aggregates session duration, completion level, posture score, recurring issues and safety warnings into the stored session result. |
| 17 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Exercise Content Publication Service | Validates exercise metadata, safety notes and status before an exercise is activated for the mobile catalog. |
| 18 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Posture Configuration Version Service | Versions analysis mode, rule/model identifier, confidence thresholds and feedback severity and applies only published configurations. |
| 19 | MF-02 Mother Care Journey | Maternal Record Soft-Deletion Service | Soft-deletes owner-entered maternal metrics or postpartum logs while retaining audit evidence and excluding deleted records from trends. |
| 20 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Baby Log Aggregation Service | Aggregates feeding, sleep, diaper, symptom and care logs into 24-hour and seven-day summaries without producing a medical diagnosis. |
| 21 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Growth and Vaccination Schedule Service | Calculates age-based growth points and reference vaccination dates, marks sources and creates due or overdue states. |
| 22 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Active Baby Context Service | Stores and validates the currently selected baby profile so logs, reminders and dashboards use the intended child. |
| 23 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Baby Record Lifecycle Service | Applies ownership, edit and soft-delete rules to baby daily logs and development milestones. |
| 24 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Vaccination Record Lifecycle Service | Creates, updates, soft-deletes, completes or postpones user-entered vaccination records and recalculates schedule status. |
| 25 | MF-03 Baby Care Journey, Growth & Vaccination | Growth Measurement Lifecycle Service | Creates, updates and soft-deletes growth measurements and rebuilds chart data from the remaining valid history. |
| 26 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Safety Screening Service | Screens posts and answers for spam, abuse, prohibited advertising and high-risk medical wording, then labels or routes suspicious content for review. |
| 27 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Post Lifecycle Service | Enforces ownership and moderation locks for create, edit, soft-delete and restore states while retaining evidence required for reports or investigations. |
| 28 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Engagement Service | Creates and removes bookmarks, answer likes and topic follows idempotently, updates counters and excludes hidden or deleted content. |
| 29 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Moderation Queue Builder | Prioritizes cases from user reports, automated safety flags, repeated violations and escalated health-risk content. |
| 30 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Moderation Action Propagation Service | Applies approved hide, lock, warn or suspend actions to related content and accounts, sends notices and records the result. |
| 31 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Question Search Index Job | Indexes eligible community questions and answers after create, edit, moderation or deletion and supports keyword and structured filters. |
| 32 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Topic Search and Follow Service | Indexes active topics, returns topic discovery results and maintains follow subscriptions used for feed personalization and notifications. |
| 33 | MF-04 Community Q\&A & Moderation | Community Answer Lifecycle Service | Enforces author ownership and moderation locks for editing and soft-deleting the user’s own answers. |
| 34 | MF-05 Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Expert Availability and Presence Service | Maintains expert availability, support-method, service-area and nearby-support readiness states and automatically expires stale presence. |
| 35 | MF-05 Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Expert Search and Filter Service | Searches only eligible verified experts and applies specialty, availability, badge and consented service-area filters. |
| 36 | MF-05 Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Expert Matching and Nearby Search Service | Returns only verified, eligible and opted-in nearby experts using privacy-safe location precision and current availability. |
| 37 | MF-05 Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Contribution Point Calculation Job | Calculates expert contribution points and badges from eligible answers, likes and moderation outcomes while excluding removed activity. |
| 38 | MF-05 Verified Expert Network & Contribution | Expert Search Index Synchronization Job | Updates searchable expert fields, badge, availability and suspension state so ineligible experts are removed promptly. |
| 39 | MF-06 AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage | Structured Symptom Intake Service | Transforms user answers and selected context into a structured intake record for controlled safety processing. |
| 40 | MF-06 AI Nurse Assistant & Risk Triage | Risk Triage and Red-Flag Rule Engine | Applies controlled green, yellow and red rules; red flags prioritize emergency or in-person care and never diagnose or prescribe. |
| 41 | MF-06 / MF-11 AI Triage & Verified Content | Verified RAG Answer Service | Retrieves approved content, FAQ and checklist sources and returns bounded answers with citations and safe fallback. |
| 42 | MF-07 Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support | Map Geocoding, Nearby Search and ETA Service | Geocodes approved locations, searches nearby care facilities or opted-in experts and calculates distance, route and ETA. |
| 43 | MF-07 Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support | Location Privacy and Expiry Service | Limits location precision and visibility by role and purpose and automatically ends sharing when its TTL expires. |
| 44 | MF-07 Emergency Map & Nearby Care Support | Nearby Support Request Routing Service | Matches consented support requests with eligible experts and shares only minimum necessary information until expiry or cancellation. |
| 45 | MF-08 Personal Health Records & Source Labeling | Health Summary Generation Service | Builds a time-bounded summary from records explicitly selected by the owner and applies source labels and permission scope. |
| 46 | MF-08 Personal Health Records & Source Labeling | Secure File Upload Processing Service | Validates ownership, file type and size, scans content, stores metadata and protects storage references. |
| 47 | MF-08 Personal Health Records & Source Labeling | Protected File Access Service | Authorizes preview or download by ownership, consent scope and expiry and issues a short-lived protected file URL. |
| 48 | MF-08 Personal Health Records & Source Labeling | File Deletion and Retention Service | Soft-deletes eligible owner files, blocks deletion when retention or record links apply and schedules physical purge when allowed. |
| 49 | MF-08 Personal Health Records & Source Labeling | Health Record Detail Authorization Service | Returns metadata and protected attachments only when ownership or a valid consent scope permits access. |
| 50 | MF-09 Reminders, Tasks & Care Plan | Reminder Scheduling and Dispatch Job | Finds due appointment, medication, vaccination, checklist and family-task reminders and creates reminder notifications. |
| 51 | MF-09 Reminders, Tasks & Care Plan | Reminder Recurrence and Snooze Service | Calculates the next occurrence, snooze time, completion and missed state while preventing duplicate delivery. |
| 52 | MF-09 Reminders, Tasks & Care Plan | Reminder Lifecycle Service | Applies complete, skip and delete actions, updates recurrence and prevents a skipped occurrence from deleting the recurring configuration. |
| 53 | MF-10 Family Sync & Cooperative Care | Care Group Invitation Service | Creates expiring invitations, validates acceptance, prevents duplicate membership and initializes granted permissions. |
| 54 | MF-10 Family Sync & Cooperative Care | Family Alert Distribution Service | Sends consent-limited alerts and task updates only to active members whose scope includes the event type. |
| 55 | MF-10 Family Sync & Cooperative Care | Care Group Membership Lifecycle Service | Revokes pending invitations, removes members, handles voluntary leave and immediately terminates associated data permissions. |
| 56 | MF-10 Family Sync & Cooperative Care | Family Task Lifecycle Service | Validates task ownership and status transitions for detail view, update, cancellation and assignee notification. |
| 57 | MF-11 Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Content Versioning and Publication Service | Stores immutable versions, manages draft and approval state and exposes only the latest approved version. |
| 58 | MF-11 Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Scheduled Content Publication Job | Publishes or unpublishes approved content at configured times and invalidates affected search indexes. |
| 59 | MF-11 Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Verified Content Search Service | Indexes and searches only approved, currently published articles, FAQs and checklists by keyword, stage and category. |
| 60 | MF-11 Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Content Category Management Service | Creates, reorders, updates and hides content categories while preserving references from historical content versions. |
| 61 | MF-11 Verified Content & Checklist Hub | Content Unpublication Service | Removes an approved version from user visibility without deleting its version history or audit trail. |
| 62 | MF-12 Expense & Preparation Planner | Expense Summary Aggregation Service | Aggregates owner-entered preparation expenses by category, month or journey/baby period without treating the result as accounting or financial advice. |
| 63 | MF-13 Connected Device & Health Data Integration | Health Platform Synchronization Service | Imports supported observations, normalizes units, attaches source and timestamp labels and prevents duplicate records. |
| 64 | MF-13 Connected Device & Health Data Integration | Device Synchronization Retry Job | Retries recoverable failures with backoff and marks stale or permanently failed imports without fabricating values. |

| 66 | MF-14 Smart Activity Monitoring & Safety Support | On-Device IMU Event Detection Service | Processes accelerometer and gyroscope signals on-device to identify a suspected fall or strong impact and starts a safety check. |
| 67 | MF-14 Smart Activity Monitoring & Safety Support | Safety Confirmation Countdown Service | Tracks the response window, cancels escalation when safety is confirmed and continues when help is requested or no response occurs. |
| 68 | MF-14 Smart Activity Monitoring & Safety Support | Emergency Contact Verification Service | Adds, verifies, prioritizes and removes emergency contacts and checks that at least one active recipient is available before alerting. |
| 69 | MF-14 Smart Activity Monitoring & Safety Support | Safety Alert Escalation Service | Sends the minimum necessary emergency alert and consented location, records delivery and offers MF-07 emergency-map actions while prioritizing emergency services for red flags. |
| 70 | CC-01 Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Audit Logging Service | Records authentication, sensitive access, consent changes, protected-file activity, expert trust, moderation and safety actions in append-only audit logs. |
| 71 | CC-01 Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Security Event Detection Service | Detects anomalous login, permission, file-access and sensitive-record patterns and creates reviewable security events with supporting evidence. |
| 72 | CC-01 Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Security Incident Investigation Service | Links security events, audit records and evidence into an investigation case, tracks containment and resolution and records the final decision. |
| 73 | CC-01 Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Account and Content Risk Scoring Service | Combines report frequency, prohibited patterns and enforcement history to prioritize human review without making medical decisions. |
| 74 | CC-01 Safety, Compliance & Abuse Prevention | Data Retention and Soft-Deletion Job | Applies retention, anonymization and purge rules to deleted or deactivated accounts and expired data while preserving required evidence. |

| 76 | Cross-cutting Notifications | Notification Queue and Delivery Service | Queues in-app, push and email messages, applies preferences and mandatory-safety rules, retries failures and stores delivery status. |
| 77 | Cross-cutting Notifications | Emergency Notification Delivery Service | Bypasses noncritical muting where policy permits, sends to verified emergency contacts, tracks acknowledgements and escalates failed delivery safely. |

  **Entities Description**

| \# | Entity | Description |
| :---: | ----- | ----- |
| 1 | roles | Catalog of system roles used for RBAC, including USER, MOTHER, FAMILY\_MEMBER, EXPERT, MODERATOR, CONTENT\_ADMIN, and ADMIN. |
| 2 | users | Root account entity for all CareBridge users; stores identity and account-status data without mixing health records or community-profile data. |
| 3 | user\_roles | Junction entity that resolves the many-to-many relationship between users and roles. |
| 4 | user\_sessions | User login sessions and refresh tokens used to support viewing and revoking sessions on other devices. |
| 5 | community\_profiles | Public community display profile separated from identity records and health profiles. |
| 6 | notification\_preferences | Per-user settings for notification channels and notification categories. |
| 7 | notifications | Personal notifications generated by the system from reminders, community activity, consultations, safety events, or operations. |
| 8 | data\_permissions | Data-sharing permissions granted by users to family members or experts by scope, purpose, and expiry time. |
| 9 | audit\_logs | Immutable log of important actions such as login, profile viewing, permission changes, moderation, consultation, payment, and safety events. |
| 10 | mother\_journeys | Mother care journeys by pre-pregnancy, pregnancy, or postpartum state; one user may have multiple journeys over time. |
| 11 | maternal\_health\_metrics | Maternal health metrics entered manually or synchronized from another source, with source labeling. |
| 12 | postpartum\_logs | Postpartum recovery logs covering discharge, pain, breast milk, sleep, mood, and symptoms. |
| 13 | baby\_profiles | Baby profiles created and managed by the mother or authorized caregiver. |
| 14 | baby\_daily\_logs | Daily baby logs for feeding, sleep, diaper, temperature, reflux/vomiting, prescribed medicine, and notes. |
| 15 | development\_milestones | Baby development milestones such as rolling, crawling, walking, speaking, teething, or weaning. |
| 16 | growth\_measurements | Weight, height, and head-circumference measurements used to build growth charts. |
| 17 | vaccination\_records | Baby vaccination schedule and status data; used for personal tracking and not as a replacement for the official vaccination book. |
| 18 | health\_records | Personal health-record repository for mothers and babies, including ultrasound images, lab results, prescriptions, vaccination slips, and clinical results, with source labels. |
| 19 | health\_summaries | Time-bounded health-data summaries generated by users for viewing or temporary sharing. |
| 20 | reminders | Reminders for appointments, medicine or vitamins, vaccination, checklists, and care tasks. |
| 21 | care\_groups | Care groups created by the mother or manager for a journey or baby. |
| 22 | care\_group\_members | Junction entity between care\_groups and users; stores invitation status and member permissions. |
| 23 | care\_tasks | Care tasks assigned to group members, with due dates and completion status. |
| 24 | expenses | Expenses related to pregnancy, postpartum care, or baby care. |
| 25 | community\_topics | Community topic catalog used to classify questions and content. |
| 26 | community\_questions | Questions posted by users; may appear anonymous publicly while remaining internally traceable. |
| 27 | community\_answers | Answers from users or experts; expert answers carry badge and professional-scope information. |
| 28 | content\_reports | Reports submitted by users for violating content or accounts. |
| 29 | moderation\_actions | Moderation actions for reports or content, such as approve, hide, lock, warn, or suspend. |
| 30 | content\_items | Articles, FAQs, or educational content created and moderated by content administrators. |
| 31 | checklist\_templates | Moderated checklist templates for preparation by care stage. |
| 32 | checklist\_items | Child items belonging to a checklist template. |
| 33 | expert\_profiles | Professional profiles for registered doctors or experts; verification badge is granted only after admin approval. |
| 34 | expert\_credentials | Uploaded expert documents and certificates used for verification. |
| 35 | expert\_availability | Expert availability slots for consultations, including support mode and slot status; prices are versioned separately in expert\_consultation\_prices. |
| 36 | expert\_location\_shares | Expert-shared location or service area, controlled by consent and expiry, to support nearby search. |
| 37 | consultation\_bookings | Consultation booking request between a user and expert; locks the price snapshot, commission rate, and cancellation policy at confirmation or payment time. |
| 38 | consultation\_sessions | Chat, voice-call, or video-call sessions created from valid bookings. |
| 39 | consultation\_messages | Messages exchanged during consultation sessions, protected so only authorized parties can access them. |
| 40 | payment\_transactions | Payment transactions for bookings based on the price snapshot, including gross price, gateway fee, refund amount, net amount, and transaction status. |
| 41 | commission\_records | Commission calculation result after an eligible completed session, including original price, commission rate or amount, gateway fee, refund, expert net amount, and reconciliation status. |
| 42 | expert\_reviews | Expert reviews created only after a valid completed booking. |
| 43 | contribution\_points | Contribution point and badge history for users or experts based on community activity. |
| 44 | consultation\_price\_bands | Versioned CareBridge price bands by consultation mode, duration, and professional scope, including minimum price, maximum price, commission rate, and effective period. |
| 45 | expert\_consultation\_prices | Versioned expert-specific consultation prices within allowed bands; new prices apply only to future bookings and never retroactively change locked bookings. |
| 46 | consultation\_disputes | Consultation dispute records with reason, evidence, handling status, and operations decision. |
| 47 | refund\_records | Refund records linked to transactions and disputes, storing refund amount, processing status, and payment-gateway refund code. |
| 48 | settlement\_records | Expert settlement records by period or commission item, including gross value, commission, gateway fee, refund, net payout, and payment status. |
| 49 | triage\_assessments | Structured symptom-intake sessions with green, yellow, or red risk classification; not a medical diagnosis. |
| 50 | triage\_answers | Step-by-step answers submitted during a symptom-intake session. |
| 51 | care\_facilities | Healthcare-facility catalog used for emergency maps and nearby search; records come from approved map or administrative sources. |
| 52 | emergency\_events | Emergency or support-search flow opened by the user or system from triage, emergency button, or IMU event. |
| 53 | location\_snapshots | Minimal time-limited location snapshots used for emergency, family alerts, or nearby search. |
| 54 | health\_device\_connections | Optional smartwatch or health-platform connections storing secure token references and consent status. |
| 55 | device\_measurements | Device or health-platform measurements with source and confidence labels; used for trend viewing and not as a substitute for clinical measurement. |
| 56 | safety\_monitoring\_settings | Configuration for IMU monitoring, countdown, alert recipients, and location consent. |
| 57 | safety\_events | Suspected fall or strong-impact events detected from IMU data; stores minimal metadata and does not assert injury. |
| 58 | safety\_alerts | Minimal alerts sent to family members after the user requests help or does not respond. |
| 59 | pregnancy\_exercises | Moderated pregnancy-exercise catalog with trimester scope, difficulty, duration, instructions, safety warnings, and version status. |
| 60 | exercise\_safety\_checks | Mother's pre-exercise safety-check results for a specific exercise and journey, including structured answers, red flags, and allow-or-block decision. |
| 61 | exercise\_sessions | Mother's pregnancy-exercise sessions, storing time, pause/completion status, completion level, aggregate posture score, and alerts. |
| 62 | posture\_analysis\_configs | Rule-based or ML-based posture-analysis configuration for each exercise, including rule or model version, confidence threshold, and effective period. |
| 63 | posture\_feedback\_events | Posture feedback events generated during an exercise session; stores only necessary result/keypoint summaries and no raw camera video. |

| Stage and Topic Mapping | Maps the draft to applicable care stages and topics. |
